school_notes: Term 1 official staff start is 28 January; government students start 29 January, used here.
Official government-school dates do not establish every independent/Catholic school or local pupil-free day.
Term intervals include weekends; distinguish weekday school days and public holidays when comparing travel patterns.
2025 school terms are not all eight weeks long. An explicitly defined eight-week comparison can use Term 4 weeks 1–8, 6 October–30 November, with public holidays flagged separately.

weather_events.name: Melbourne damaging-wind event
weather_events.evidence: Bureau summary identifies damaging winds across Victoria and Melbourne on 22 October. Scoresby maximum gust 70 km/h at 17:10 local; Melbourne Airport 94 km/h and Fawkner Beacon 107 km/h support metropolitan exposure.
weather_events.location_limit: Scoresby is an eastern-Melbourne proxy, not a colocated measurement at SCATS 100:2.

weather_events.name: Melbourne heavy-rain/severe-weather window
weather_events.evidence: The low crossed Bass Strait on 26 October; rain and severe storms affected Victoria/Greater Melbourne. Olympic Park 35.4 mm and Scoresby 19.6 mm were reported for the 24 hours to 9 am on 27 October.
weather_events.location_limit: Use the two-day window; a regional event flag does not prove causation or a lane-specific traffic disruption.

excluded_event.name: Severe Tropical Cyclone Alfred
excluded_event.reason: Documented major impacts are southeast Queensland/northeast New South Wales. Do not label Melbourne traffic as cyclone-exposed; cyclone robustness requires suitable affected-region traffic data.

time_alignment_notes: SCATS published interval ends use fixed AEST UTC+10. Convert interval-start time (end minus 15 minutes) to Australia/Melbourne before assigning local event dates.
Melbourne DST calendar days can contain 92 or 100 quarter-hour intervals; ordinary days contain 96. Daily means should show interval coverage rather than silently forcing 96.
Bureau daily rainfall is measured over 24 hours ending 9 am local, not civil midnight-to-midnight.
Event markers are exposure/context indicators, not ground-truth anomaly or incident labels. Do not estimate anomaly-detection F1 from calendar holidays alone.

full_year_dataset_availability.note: Local official catalogue contains all 12 monthly 2025 resources, including December 2025. Record-level extraction/quality still needs checking.
